ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 92% of the visible ventral surface, bounded by a low-intensity black perimeter representing approximately 8% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white macro-region across both lobes; continuous thin black band along the trailing edge; single distinct circular grey pixel cluster on the right lobe at upper-mid height; small dark pixel clusters localized at the lower central vertical axis.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an acute interior angle estimated at 55 degrees; notch depth is approximately 15% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated boundary; high-frequency peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels; most aggressive serration patterns located at distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal trajectory; proximal concavity adjacent to the median notch transitioning to broad convexity towards the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible circular greyish focal spot on the upper-right lobe; group of small dark clusters located at the base of the notch insertion.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme high-frequency jaggedness and structural irregularity at both distal tips consistent with localized trauma or heavy barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical dark pigmentation streak positioned centrally below the median notch.
